title: Lustrzany taniec
evidence: Guest Windows-1250 text file identifies Lois McMaster Bujold, Mirror Dance and translator Łukasz Praski. Checked the opening, the chapter sequence through chapter 33 and the final scene with Mark and Miles arriving at the Vorkosigan residence. Rights unknown.

title: Siedem spojrzeń na wąwóz Olduvai
evidence: Guest anthology PDF gives Mike Resnick’s original title and Anna Klimasara’s translation credit. The story begins on physical page 45 and concludes on page 99 before Łowy na Snarka. A different web transcription starts partway into the story. Rights unknown.

title: Drugi wzrok
pub: Polish text of None So Blind
evidence: Guest UTF-8 file names Joe Haldeman. Checked Cletus Jefferson’s opening question, the final contrast between two forms of blindness, and the biographical note identifying the original Hugo-winning story. The copy’s translator line is incomplete. Rights unknown.

title: Dziecko z Marsa
pub: Polish magazine text of The Martian Child
evidence: Guest UTF-8 file identifies David Gerrold. Checked the adoption-office opening about Dennis and the final scene before the magazine note, which identifies this as the Hugo-winning short work. Rights unknown.

title: Śmierć na Nilu
pub: Polish text of Death on the Nile
evidence: Guest UTF-8 file identifies Connie Willis. Checked Zoe reading aboard the plane to Egypt, the chapter structure and the final stairway scene mentioning Osiris and Poirot. This is Willis’s short story. Rights unknown.

title: Księga Sądu Ostatecznego
evidence: Guest 446-page PDF identifies Connie Willis, Doomsday Book and translator Arkadiusz Nakoniecznik. Checked the opening, chapter 36 and the closing scene with Kivrin and Dunworthy before the biographical material and notes. Rights unknown.

title: Ballada o Billu Pąklarzu
evidence: Guest UTF-8 text file identifies Lucius Shepard, Barnacle Bill the Spacer and translator Michał Jakuszewski. Checked the narrator’s opening and the concluding passage before the repeated translation credit. Rights unknown.

title: Nawet królowa
evidence: Guest anthology HTML contains the story headed Connie Willis and credited to Dorota Malinowska. Checked the narrator’s opening and the final family exchange immediately before the next author, Pamela Sargent. Rights unknown.

title: Gra

evidence: Guest Windows-1250 file identifies Lois McMaster Bujold and the Polish title. Checked Miles’s opening assignment, chapter 17 and his final exchange with the head of Imperial Security. Rights unknown.

title: Manamouki
evidence: Guest Polish collection PDF, physical pages 364–398. Matched Mike Resnick’s original title and Paulina Braiter’s translation credit. The closing reflection precedes a different Kirinyaga story on page 399. Rights unknown.

title: Hyperion
evidence: Guest 483-page PDF identifies Dan Simmons. Checked the Consul’s prologue, pilgrim narratives, and the epilogue on pages 479–483 ending with the group entering the valley. Rights unknown.

title: Lamentowe Góry
evidence: Guest collection PDF identifies Lois McMaster Bujold. The story begins on physical page 9 and ends on page 56 with Miles’s decision and Dorota Malinowska’s translation credit. The frame narrative resumes on page 57 and Labirynt begins on page 58. Rights unknown.

title: Ogień nad Otchłanią
evidence: Guest EPUB download is linked from Booktown. Its editorial page identifies Vernor Vinge’s A Fire Upon the Deep. XHTML contains the prologue and actual Polish narrative through part of chapter seven, followed by a purchase notice. This is an additional format to the existing Legimi sample.
